en: Don't laugh at my mistakes.
cn: 不要嘲笑我的错误。

en: The company is ready to launch its new product into the market.
cn: 公司已准备好把它的新产品投入市场。

en: The small road leads onto the main highway.
cn: 这条小路把我们带上了主高速公路。

en: The path leads us to the hidden waterfall.
cn: 这条小路带着我们到隐藏的瀑布。

en: Smoking can lead to serious health problems.
cn: 吸烟会导致严重的健康问题。

en: We learn about different cultures in this class. || I want to learn about the history of this city.
cn: 在这门课上我们了解不同的文化。 || 我想学习这座城市的历史。

en: You can learn a lot from your mistakes.
cn: 你可以从错误中学习到很多。

en: Don't leave your passport behind when you travel.
cn: 旅行时不要遗忘你的护照。

en: I promised I wouldn't let you down.
cn: 我保证不会让你失望。

en: He spent the whole summer just lying around and watching TV.
cn: 他整个夏天都在无所事事地混日子看电视。

en: The city lights up at night.
cn: 这座城市在夜晚被点亮。

en: I like doing yoga in the morning.
cn: 我喜欢在早上做瑜伽。

en: I like to listen to music while studying.
cn: 我喜欢边学习边听音乐。

en: You should listen to your parents.
cn: 你应该听你的父母说。

en: In hard times, some people had to live on potatoes alone.
cn: 在困难时期，有些人不得不只靠土豆为生。

en: She decided to live with her sister after college.
cn: 她决定大学毕业后和她姐姐一起生活。

en: Who will look after your dog while you are away?
cn: 你不在的时候谁会照顾你的狗？

en: Please look after my dog; Look at the picture; Look for your keys; Look up the word.
cn: 请照顾我的狗；看图片；查找你的钥匙；向上看这个词。

en: We stopped to look around the square.
cn: 我们停下来环顾四周的广场。

en: Please look at the board now.
cn: 现在请看黑板。

en: He looked away, feeling embarrassed.
cn: 他移开目光，感到很尴尬。

en: We looked down from the top of the tower.
cn: 我们从塔顶俯视。

en: You should not look down upon people just because they are poor.
cn: 你不应该仅仅因为别人穷就瞧不起某人。

en: I look forward to hearing from you.
cn: 我盼望收到你的来信。

en: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
cn: 我期待很快收到你的来信。

en: The police are looking into the cause of the fire.
cn: 警察正在调查火灾的原因。

en: You look like your mother.
cn: 你看起来像你的妈妈。

en: Even when things are tough, try to look on the bright side.
cn: 即使事情艰难，也要尝试保持乐观。

en: Look out! There is a car coming! || Look out! There is a car coming!
cn: 小心！有车过来了！ || 当心！有辆车来了！

en: The inspector will look over the damage.
cn: 检查员将察看损坏情况。

en: Look up the word in a dictionary.
cn: 在字典中查阅这个词。

en: If you don't know the word, you should look it up in a dictionary.
cn: 如果你不认识这个词，你应该在字典中查找它。

en: Children often look up to their parents.
cn: 孩子们通常尊敬他们的父母。

en: He worked hard to make it in the business world.
cn: 他努力工作以在商界获得成功。

en: My father made me a wooden toy car.
cn: 我父亲为我制造了一辆木制玩具车。

en: Did you make up that story?
cn: 你编造了那个故事吗？

en: Measure the length of the table with a ruler.
cn: 用尺子量桌子的长度。

en: It's time to move on and forget the past.
cn: 是时候继续前进，忘记过去了。

en: He offered to help me move the furniture.
cn: 他主动帮我搬家具。

en: We need to pack up our belongings before moving.
cn: 搬家前我们需要收拾好我们的物品。

en: His grandfather passed away peacefully last night.
cn: 他的祖父昨晚平静地去世了。

en: The bus passed by the school without stopping.
cn: 公共汽车通过了学校没有停。

en: He passed out from the heat.
cn: 他因为中暑而昏迷。

en: I promised to pay back the money by Friday.
cn: 我承诺在周五前偿还这笔钱。

en: Did you pay for the coffee?
cn: 你为咖啡付费了吗？

en: Please pick up the trash on the floor.
cn: 请捡起地板上的垃圾。

en: Our team will play against the champions next week.
cn: 我们的队伍下周将同冠军队比赛。

en: She pointed out the mistake in the report.
cn: 她指出了报告中的错误。

en: He pointed to the mountains in the distance; Don't point at people, it's rude.
cn: 他指向远处的山；不要指向人，这是粗鲁的。

en: His eyes popped out in surprise.
cn: 他惊讶地瞪大了眼睛。

en: Pour the milk into the bowl and stir.
cn: 把牛奶倒进碗里搅拌。

en: I prefer to drink tea rather than coffee.
cn: 我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

en: We need to prepare for the coming storm.
cn: 我们需要为即将到来的暴风雨做准备。

en: Put the books back into the shelf.
cn: 把书放回书架。

en: Put on your coat before you go out. || The students will put on a play next week. || Put on your shoes before leaving; She put on weight.
cn: 在你出门前穿上你的外套。 || 学生们下周将上演一部话剧。 || 出门前穿上你的鞋；她增加了体重。

en: Put on your coat; Put the book down; Put up a tent; Put up a poster.
cn: 穿上你的外套；放下书；搭起帐篷；张贴海报。

en: The firefighters put out the fire.
cn: 消防员扑灭了火灾。

en: I can't put up with his constant complaining anymore.
cn: 我再也无法忍受他不停的抱怨了。

en: The teacher asked the students to read the poem aloud.
cn: 老师要求学生们大声朗读这首诗。

en: Can you recommend a good book to me?
cn: 你能向我推荐一本好书吗？

en: This chapter refers to the causes of the war.
cn: 本章涉及战争的原因。

en: Despite the economic crisis, the restaurant managed to remain in business.
cn: 尽管有经济危机，这家餐厅设法继续营业。

en: This song reminds me of my childhood.
cn: 这首歌使我想起我的童年。

en: He said goodbye and quickly rang off.
cn: 他说了再见，然后快速挂断电话。

en: I am busy right now; can I ring you back in an hour?
cn: 我现在很忙；我能在一小时内回电话给你吗？

en: I need to ring up my doctor for an appointment.
cn: 我需要打电话给我的医生预约。

en: The water level can rise by several meters during the flood.
cn: 洪水期间，水位可以升高数米。

en: We have run out of milk, so I need to buy some.
cn: 我们的牛奶用完了，所以我需要去买一些。

en: The bathtub is running over!
cn: 浴缸里的水溢出来了！

en: He rushed out of the room when he heard the alarm.
cn: 他听到警报后冲出了房间。

en: We went to the airport to see our friends off.
cn: 我们去机场送我们的朋友。

en: Despite the pressure, the speaker seemed relaxed.
cn: 尽管有压力，这位演讲者看起来放松。

en: The concert tickets sold out in minutes.
cn: 音乐会门票在几分钟内卖光了。

en: If you feel worse, we will send for a doctor.
cn: 如果你感觉更糟，我们会派人去请一位医生。

en: The company will send out the invitations next week.
cn: 公司下周将送出邀请函。

en: The judge decided to send the criminal to prison.
cn: 法官决定把罪犯关进监狱。

en: We set off early in the morning to avoid traffic.
cn: 我们一大早就出发以避开交通。

en: They set off for the USA early this morning.
cn: 他们今天早上动身去美国了。

en: They set up a new business last year.
cn: 他们去年建立了一家新公司。

en: Always share your toys with your younger brother.
cn: 总是与你的弟弟分享你的玩具。

en: A meteor shot across the night sky.
cn: 一颗流星划过了夜空。

en: The teacher shouted at the noisy students.
cn: 老师对着喧闹的学生喊叫。

en: There is no need to shout at me.
cn: 没有必要朝我喊叫。

en: We spent the afternoon just sitting around and chatting.
cn: 我们花了一个下午无所事事地坐着聊天。

en: The computer tends to slow down when I open too many apps.
cn: 当我打开太多应用程序时，电脑反应会变慢。

en: She smiled at me across the room.
cn: 她隔着房间朝我微笑。

en: In the crowded bus, people had to stand close to each other.
cn: 在拥挤的公共汽车上，人们不得不彼此站得很近。

en: The letters "CEO" stand for Chief Executive Officer.
cn: “CEO”代表首席执行官。

en: It's rude to stare at people.
cn: 盯着别人看是很不礼貌的。

en: Let’s start with the first chapter of the book.
cn: 我们从书的第一章开始吧。

en: You should stay away from that area, it's dangerous. || Try to stay away from crowds during the flu season.
cn: 你应该离开那个区域，那里很危险。 || 在流感季节尽量远离人群。

en: I can't stay long, I have another appointment.
cn: 我不能待很久，我还有另一个约会。

en: The doctor asked the patient to stay still during the procedure.
cn: 医生要求病人在手术过程中保持不动。

en: Despite the changes around it, the old building will stay the same.
cn: 尽管周围环境发生了变化，这座旧建筑将保持不变。

en: Be careful when you step onto the train.
cn: 当你踏上火车时要小心。

en: Stick with your plan until the end.
cn: 坚持你的计划直到最后。

en: You should stop eating junk food.
cn: 你应该停止吃垃圾食品。

en: The machine stopped making a noise.
cn: 机器停止了发出噪音。

en: The rain stopped us from going for a walk.
cn: 雨阻止了我们去散步。

en: The fence stopped the children from entering the road.
cn: 围栏阻止了孩子们进入马路。
